about: Front ES-SPLIT (docs/I18N.md, "Spanish: the chunk split by route area"): every catalog key built at run time, as `file › place · t(<argument>)` or `file › place · head '<head>'`, with the contexts of its file in brackets (core, or the route areas whose roots reach it). A key built from a head goes to the module of the files holding any head that matches it (and of any file naming it literally); a t(<non-literal>) site with no head sends its keys to the core only when nothing else names them, so a new site in a core file is a one-line diff for the reviewer. src/i18n/split.test.ts compares; OPENVIREO_REFRESH_PINS=1 npx vitest run src/i18n/split.test.ts rewrites it (then review the git diff).
